meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: Claude 会检查或设置 claude-mem 云同步:把 cmem.ai Connect 给出的三个连接值写入本地设置,重启 worker 验证 SyncHub 连接,再报告设备 ID、待处理条数、上次刷新与 Hub 状态,且不打印同步令牌。
howto.when: 当你提到 “set up cloud sync”、“sync my memories”、“sync status” 等关键词,或想把记忆数据库备份、同步到 cmem.ai 账户时触发。

say.text: 检查我的记忆同步状态
say.note: 查询本地 worker 的同步状态并汇报

say.text: 帮我设置 cmem.ai 云同步
say.note: 会向你要同步令牌、用户 ID 和 SyncHub 地址

say.text: 把我的记忆同步到 cmem.ai 账户
say.note: 写入连接值后重启 worker 并验证

howto.what_en: Sets up or checks claude-mem cloud sync: writes the three values from cmem.ai → Connect, restarts the worker, verifies the SyncHub link, and reports device id, pending counts, last flush, and Hub reachability. Never prints the token.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “set up cloud sync”, “sync my memories”, “sync status”, or want your memory database backed up or synced to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Queries the local worker and reports sync state

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync with cmem.ai
say_en.note: Asks for token, user id, and SyncHub URL

say_en.text: Sync my memories to my cmem.ai account
